gen-fs-oswald-gf-inclusive-sans: Tightly knit rows give Oswald a confident, display-weight stance, strong from the first line. But Inclusive Sans softens the mood, its round letters ending in open curves that feel friendly and current.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-inria-sans: Oswald sets its confident letters in tightly knit rows, strong and compact like a display face should be. Inria Sans, with strokes like bent copper pipe, gives text a rounded, see-through texture below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-istok-web: Oswald speaks with confident strength, its lines knitted tightly into rows. Istok Web takes over in rounded, approachable sans-serif letters with a clearly open side, so paragraphs feel modern and friendly all the way down.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-jura: Confident and tightly knit, Oswald lines up its display letters like a row of strong shoulders. Jura, drawn in wire-like strokes of constant weight, wants a little extra size to stay comfortable underneath.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-k2d: Oswald brings confident strength, its display letters knitted into tight rows. K2D holds a tube-like line through every bend, and that steady thickness is what makes the pair work.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kanchenjunga: Kanchenjunga reads with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, crisp shapes that never clog at low resolution. Oswald up top adds confident, tightly knit display punch to the mix.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kantumruy-pro: Strong first, friendly second: Oswald's tightly knit rows meet softer, hairline-free letters in the text. Kantumruy Pro keeps its e open clearly to the right, a plain sans that stays approachable under the heading.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kodchasan: Oswald is all about confident, tightly knit rows, built to hit hard as a display face. Kodchasan handles the quieter work, with terminals that hang open and no calligraphic thinning.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-koho: Wide c apertures keep the body text open and clean, with Oswald overhead running confident, tight rows. KoHo is the quiet strength, plain sans letters that let Oswald's display weight do the shouting.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-kosugi: Kosugi has an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers and a wire-bent look across every word it sets. Shrink Oswald and its confident, tightly knit rows lose their punch.
